verdict: Chime's revenue grew 32% to $718M and it posted a third straight profitable quarter — $44M of net income — as lending products MyPay and Instant Loans drove platform revenue up 52%.

kpis.note: +20% YoY; record 1.8M net adds in 12 months

kpis.note: 19% margin, up from 5% a year ago

segments.name: Payments revenue
segments.note: Interchange fees from card purchases — credit-card interchange rose 81% as members shifted from debit to credit with Chime Prime. Purchase volume was $38.5B, up 19%.

segments.name: Platform-related revenue
segments.note: MyPay pay advances and Instant Loans, plus other member fees — MyPay originations hit a record $5.3B and Instant Loans $381M in the quarter.

takeaways.title: Lending is now the growth engine
takeaways.text: Platform-related revenue rose 52% to $273.6M. MyPay originations hit a record $5.3B with about $80M of transaction profit, and Instant Loans — used by more than 20% of members — originated $381M. Payments revenue still grew a solid 22% to $444.4M.

takeaways.title: Members are piling in
takeaways.text: Active Members grew 20% to 10.9 million, with a record 1.8 million net adds over the past year and about 500,000 in the quarter alone. Average revenue per member rose 10% to $270, and purchase volume grew 19% to $38.5B.

takeaways.title: Profit is real, but still thin
takeaways.text: This was Chime's third consecutive quarter of GAAP profitability: $43.7M of net income, a 6% margin, and adjusted EBITDA of $137M, a 19% margin. A $17.1M restructuring charge and $76.3M of stock-based pay sit inside the numbers. Chime raised full-year revenue guidance to $2.79–2.80B.

oneTimers: A $17.1M restructuring charge for employee severance and related costs sits inside operating expenses (Technology $8.6M, G&A $4.7M, Member support $2.0M, Sales & marketing $1.7M). Excluding it and stock-based pay, adjusted EBITDA was $137.3M.
Stock-based compensation and related payroll tax was $76.3M in the quarter — a real cost that GAAP counts and adjusted EBITDA sets aside.
otherDetail: Other income of $9.7M, net, is primarily interest and dividends earned on cash and marketable securities.
footerNote: Chime reports in thousands; figures are shown in $M with decimals so the lines add up exactly. Transaction profit (non-GAAP) was $530.5M, a 74% transaction margin.
